rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Pagerunner launches Chrome with existing user profiles via the Chrome DevTools Protocol and exposes browser control as an MCP server. It provides tools for session management, tab navigation, content extraction, screenshots, JavaScript evaluation, form filling, and clicking. Built-in features include PII anonymization with tokenization or redaction, stealth mode for anti-detection, encrypted snapshot storage for authenticated browser state, a persistent key-value store, and a daemon mode for sharing browser sessions across multiple AI coding sessions.
